eyebrow.zh: 纠正 → 约束 → 强制执行

headline.zh:
说过一次的错，
不该再说第二次。
headline.en:
A mistake you corrected once
should not come back.

sub.zh: 把一句口头纠正编译成一条检查：写文件之前看将要写入的文本，git commit 之前看整个工作区。同一句话，两个时刻各拦一次。
sub.en: Compile one sentence you said out loud into a check: the proposed text before a write, the whole worktree before a commit. The same claim, enforced at both moments.

body.zh: compile 为一次纠正推出 span 正则、content_check 和一条取反的 tree_check，然后在三处重放里全过才落盘：坏版本必须触发（fires_on_bad）、修好的工作区必须通过（passes_on_good）、最近 40 个提交零误拦。少一处，.clamp/constraints/ 里就不会多出这个文件。
body.en: For one correction, compile derives a span regex, a content_check and a negated tree_check, then has to pass three replays before it is written: the bad version must fire (fires_on_bad), the fixed worktree must pass (passes_on_good), and the last 40 commits must produce no false blocks. Miss one and nothing appears in .clamp/constraints/.

title.zh: 写之前与提交之前，各有一道闸
title.en: One gate before the write, one before the commit

body.zh: PreToolUse 只拿得到将要写入的文本（tool_input.content 与 new_string）；pre-commit 只拿得到写完之后的工作区。每条约束因此同时带 content_check 和 tree_check，任一处命中都算失败。
body.en: PreToolUse only sees the text about to be written (tool_input.content and new_string); pre-commit only sees the worktree after the write. Every constraint therefore carries both a content_check and a tree_check, and a hit on either one fails.

title.zh: 找不到 CLI，就拒绝提交
title.en: If the CLI is missing, the commit is refused

body.zh: init 把当时调用 CLI 的那条命令记进 hook，之后即使 clamp 不在 PATH 上，检查照样能跑。真找不到可执行文件时，hook 以失败关闭：拒绝这次提交，而不是悄悄跳过检查。
body.en: init records the command that invoked the CLI into the hook, so the check still runs from a shell without clamp on PATH. When no executable can be found, the hook fails closed: it refuses the commit instead of quietly skipping the check.

title.zh: 坏状态留成一条 git ref
title.en: The bad state is kept as a git ref

body.zh: fix 用临时索引把整个工作区快照下来，未跟踪文件也在内，写进 refs/clamp/bad/<id>，并立刻打印新增的行。
body.en: fix snapshots the whole worktree through a temporary index, untracked files included, and stores it at refs/clamp/bad/<id>, printing the added lines right away.

note.zh: 下面的命令与输出逐字复制自 docs/demo-results.json：一个已有 40 个提交的临时仓库，Clamp v0.1.0 实跑。页面只呈现记录，不在浏览器里执行产品。
note.en: The commands and output below are copied verbatim from docs/demo-results.json: a temporary repository with 40 commits, run against Clamp v0.1.0. This page presents the record; it does not execute the product in the browser.

body.zh: init 写出 .clamp/，在 git rev-parse --git-path hooks 解析出的目录里安装 pre-commit，并打印要粘进 Claude Code settings.json 的 PreToolUse 片段。
body.en: init writes .clamp/, installs pre-commit into the directory git rev-parse --git-path hooks resolves, and prints the PreToolUse snippet to paste into Claude Code's settings.json.

body.zh: 一个已跟踪文件被改成 toISOString()，另有一个未跟踪的 src/digest.ts。这次快照是 5eb0；4 条新增行里有一条来自未跟踪文件。
body.en: One tracked file now uses toISOString(), and src/digest.ts is still untracked. This snapshot is 5eb0; one of the four added lines comes from the untracked file.

steps.command: clamp fix --words "时间别自己拼，统一用 formatDate"

body.zh: 代码改对之后，compile 推出 span 正则、content_check 与取反的 tree_check，三处重放全过才写文件。--yes 跳过确认，供 CI 和脚本使用。
body.en: After the code is fixed, compile derives the span regex, the content_check and the negated tree_check, and writes the file only after all three replays pass. --yes skips the prompt for CI and scripts.

steps.output:
candidate 0001-no-raw-toisostring  span  src/**/*.ts  /\.toISOString\(\)/
content_check  /\.toISOString\(\)/  (PreToolUse, before the write)
tree_check     git grep --untracked -nE '\.toISOString\(\)' -- ':(glob)src/**/*.ts'  (expect: no_match, 30s)
replay    fires_on_bad yes · passes_on_good yes · baseline 40 commits · 0 blocks · 0 trigger hits
written   .clamp/constraints/0001-no-raw-toisostring.yaml

label.zh: 同一行再出现：提交被拦
label.en: The line returns: the commit is stopped

body.zh: 把 toISOString() 写回 src/digest.ts 再提交。pre-commit 打出约束 id、file:line 和失败的那条命令，以 exit 2 退出；git commit 因此返回 1，提交没有发生。
body.en: Write toISOString() back into src/digest.ts and commit again. pre-commit prints the constraint id, file:line and the failing command, then exits 2; git commit therefore returns 1 and no commit is created.

steps.command: git add -A && git commit -m "feat: weekly digest"
steps.output:
0001-no-raw-toisostring  blocked  src/digest.ts:2:  return "Digest " + d.toISOString();
  check failed: git grep --untracked -nE '\.toISOString\(\)' -- ':(glob)src/**/*.ts'
clamp: blocked the commit (exit 2) — 1 constraint(s) refused it.
clamp: fix the offending lines, or run `clamp fix --words "..."` if the rule itself is wrong.

label.zh: 同一段文本：写入之前被拦
label.en: The same text: stopped before the write

body.zh: 把 Claude Code PreToolUse 的事件 JSON 从 stdin 交给 hook：它读 tool_input.content，命中 content_check 后以 exit 2 结束，写入不会发生。
body.en: Feed the Claude Code PreToolUse event JSON to the hook on stdin: it reads tool_input.content, matches the content_check and exits 2, so the write never happens.

steps.output:
clamp: 0001-no-raw-toisostring  src/digest.ts:2  content_check /\.toISOString\(\)/ matched "return "Digest " + d.toISOString();"
clamp: blocked this write (exit 2) — 1 constraint refused it.
clamp: rewrite the offending line, or record a new correction with `clamp fix --words "..."` and `clamp compile <id>`.

title.zh: 从一次纠正到一条闸门
title.en: From one correction to one gate

body.zh: 需要 Node.js ≥ 20 与 git，在 macOS / Linux 上运行。按下面五步，在自己的仓库里走完同一条路径。
body.en: Node.js ≥ 20 and git, on macOS or Linux. Five steps take the same path inside your own repository.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/clamp.git
cd clamp
npm ci
npm run build
npm link

title.zh: 在你的仓库里装上闸门
title.en: Install the gate in your repository

steps.code:
# the agent leaves the bad line behind, then you say what is wrong
clamp fix --words "时间别自己拼，统一用 formatDate"
# fix the code by hand, then compile the correction
clamp compile 5eb0 --yes

title.zh: 接上 Claude Code 的写入前检查
title.en: Add the pre-write check in Claude Code

steps.code:
clamp replay 0001
clamp check
clamp list

limitations.zh: AST / tree-sitter 触发器不在 v0.1 里。
limitations.en: AST and tree-sitter triggers are not part of v0.1.

limitations.zh: 不做自动修复：被拦下的补丁要你自己改，Clamp 只负责拒绝。
limitations.en: No automatic fixes: a blocked patch is yours to rewrite; Clamp only refuses it.

limitations.zh: 判定不交给模型：LLM-as-judge 的裁决不在 v0.1 的范围内。
limitations.en: No model decides the verdict: LLM-as-judge rulings are outside v0.1.

limitations.zh: 不做约束冲突的自动解决。
limitations.en: There is no automatic resolution of conflicting constraints.

limitations.zh: 没有 Web UI、账号体系或多租户服务端；v0.1 是本地 CLI。
limitations.en: No web UI, accounts or multi-tenant server; v0.1 is a local CLI.

limitations.zh: 原生 Windows shell 不在 v0.1 的支持范围内。
limitations.en: Native Windows shells are not supported by v0.1.

caption.zh: 一句纠正被编译成约束，两道闸门在写入与提交之前各拦一次（示意图）
caption.en: One correction compiled into a constraint; two gates stop the same line before the write and before the commit (illustrative)

title.zh: 同一条错行，换了会话就回来了。
title.en: The same wrong line comes back in the next session.

body.zh: 团队在 Claude Code 里干活，纠正一次就够了：你改掉一行，说一句“时间别自己拼，统一用 formatDate”，然后继续。第二天新会话在另一个文件里又写了 toISOString()。规则可以被写下来，但读到不等于做到。缺的不是再提醒一次，而是执行：在写入之前、提交之前，各有一个地方替你说这句话。
body.en: A small team works in Claude Code and corrects something once: you fix one line, say “don't build dates by hand, use formatDate”, and move on. The next day a new session writes toISOString() again in another file. A rule can be written down, but reading it is not doing it. What is missing is not another reminder but enforcement: one place that says it for you before the write and before the commit.

title.zh: 一次纠正走完四个动作

body.zh: fix 把当时的工作区做成快照，未跟踪文件也在内，写进 refs/clamp/bad/<id>，并打印新增的行。你把代码改对，compile 推出 span 正则、content_check 和一条取反的 tree_check。之后 replay 随时重跑这三道闸，check 跑全部约束，list 列出已有的约束。
body.en: fix snapshots the worktree as it stands, untracked files included, stores it at refs/clamp/bad/<id> and prints the added lines. You fix the code, and compile derives a span regex, a content_check and a negated tree_check. After that, replay reruns the three gates at any time, check runs every constraint, and list shows what is stored.

alt.zh: 四个串行动作：init 写出 .clamp/ 并安装 pre-commit；fix 把工作区快照进 refs/clamp/bad/5eb0；compile 推出 span 正则与两个检查，重放 fires_on_bad、passes_on_good、40 个提交基线；enforce 在 PreToolUse 与 pre-commit 各拦一次。旁边标出被拦下的坏行与不受影响的其他文件。
alt.en: Four steps in order: init writes .clamp/ and installs pre-commit; fix snapshots the worktree into refs/clamp/bad/5eb0; compile derives a span regex and two checks and replays fires_on_bad, passes_on_good and a 40-commit baseline; enforce stops the line at PreToolUse and at pre-commit. The blocked bad line and the untouched files are marked alongside.

title.en: Two gates, each with its own evidence

body.zh: PreToolUse 在写之前运行，手上只有将要写入的文本（Write 的 tool_input.content、Edit 的 tool_input.new_string）。pre-commit 在写完之后运行，手上只有工作区。所以每条约束同时带 content_check 和 tree_check，任一处命中都失败。
body.en: PreToolUse runs before the write and holds the proposed text (Write's tool_input.content, Edit's tool_input.new_string). pre-commit runs after the write and holds the worktree. Every constraint therefore carries both a content_check and a tree_check, and a hit on either one fails.

alt.zh: 约束文件的中心位置：坏快照、工作区与提交历史喂给 compile 和 replay；同一条约束同时供 PreToolUse 的 content_check（提出的文本）与 pre-commit 的 tree_check（工作区）使用，两个表面在命中时都以 exit 2 结束。
alt.en: The constraint file at the centre: the bad snapshot, the worktree and the commit history feed compile and replay; the same constraint supplies PreToolUse's content_check over proposed text and pre-commit's tree_check over the worktree, and both surfaces exit 2 on a hit.

body.zh: 一个 TypeScript CLI：init、fix、compile、replay、check、list，加上两个 hook 入口。约束是 .clamp/constraints/ 下的 YAML，快照是 git ref，两者都跟着仓库进版本控制。团队层——托管的约束注册表与共享审计——是本地 CLI 之上的付费路径。
body.en: One TypeScript CLI: init, fix, compile, replay, check, list, plus two hook entry points. Constraints are YAML under .clamp/constraints/ and snapshots are git refs, so both travel with the repository. The team layer — a hosted constraint registry and shared audit — is the paid path on top of the local CLI.

alt.zh: 能力与边界：六个命令和两个 hook 入口围绕 .clamp/constraints/ 与 refs/clamp/bad/；左侧是本地能力，右侧虚线标出 v0.1 不做的事——AST 触发器、自动修复、LLM 裁决、自动合并冲突、插件市场、Web UI 与账号、原生 Windows。
alt.en: Capabilities and boundaries: six commands and two hook entry points around .clamp/constraints/ and refs/clamp/bad/; local capabilities on the left, and on the right a dashed boundary for what v0.1 does not do — AST triggers, auto-fix, LLM verdicts, automatic conflict resolution, a plugin marketplace, a web UI with accounts, and native Windows.

body.zh: 在 40 个提交的临时仓库里，compile 的重放结果是 fires_on_bad yes、passes_on_good yes、baseline 0 blocks。随后把同一行 toISOString() 写回去：git commit 在 pre-commit 处被拦下，exit 2，打印约束 id、file:line 和失败的命令；把同样的文本交给 PreToolUse，则在写入之前就被拒绝。下面的 demo 是这场运行的逐字记录。
body.en: In a temporary repository with 40 commits, compile replays as fires_on_bad yes, passes_on_good yes and a baseline of 0 blocks. Then the same toISOString() line comes back: git commit is stopped at pre-commit with exit 2, printing the constraint id, file:line and the failing command; the same text handed to PreToolUse is refused before the write. The demo below is the verbatim record of that run.

alt.zh: 同一次运行里的两道拦截：pre-commit 打印 0001-no-raw-toisostring、src/digest.ts:2 与失败的 git grep 命令后以 exit 2 退出；PreToolUse 对同一段提出的文本以 exit 2 结束。两次都没有产生新的提交或文件写入。
alt.en: Two blocks from the same run: pre-commit prints 0001-no-raw-toisostring, src/digest.ts:2 and the failing git grep command, then exits 2; PreToolUse exits 2 on the same proposed text. Neither produced a new commit or a file write.

body.zh: 一条约束就是一个 YAML：claim 是你当时说的那句话（--words），trigger 记下 span 与 glob，content_check 与 tree_check 分别对应两个表面，provenance 记下坏快照与 diff 基线。version 会出现在 replay 的输出里，一条拦截日志因此能说清是哪一版规则拦的。
body.en: A constraint is one YAML file: claim holds the sentence you said (--words), trigger records the span and glob, content_check and tree_check belong to the two surfaces, and provenance records the bad snapshot and the diff base. version appears in replay's output, so a block log can say which version stopped it.

details.code:
id: 0001-no-raw-toisostring
claim: 时间别自己拼，统一用 formatDate
enforcement: block
trigger:
  kind: span
  glob: src/**/*.ts
  pattern: \.toISOString\(\)
content_check:
  pattern: \.toISOString\(\)
tree_check:
  cmd: git grep --untracked -nE '\.toISOString\(\)' -- ':(glob)src/**/*.ts'
  timeout_sec: 30
  expect: no_match
provenance:
  bad_ref: refs/clamp/bad/5eb0
  good_ref: worktree
  words: 时间别自己拼，统一用 formatDate
  model: template
version: 783fc9b87f68

body.zh: tree_check 是一条取反的 git grep，命令里带 --untracked，expect 是 no_match。content_check 用同一个正则，跑在 hook 事件给出的文本上。init 打印的片段把后者接进 Claude Code；前者由 pre-commit 执行。
body.en: tree_check is a negated git grep: the command carries --untracked and expect is no_match. content_check applies the same regex to the text in the hook event. The snippet init prints wires the second one into Claude Code; pre-commit runs the first one.

title.zh: 团队层是另一条付费路径
title.en: The team layer is a separate paid path

body.zh: v0.1 交付的是本地 CLI；付费路径是它之上的团队层：托管的约束注册表与共享审计，让同一条纠正在多个仓库之间保持一致。这是一个方向，不代表 v0.1 已经包含托管服务。
body.en: v0.1 ships the local CLI; the paid path is the team layer on top of it: a hosted constraint registry and shared audit, so the same correction stays consistent across repositories. That is a direction, not something v0.1 already hosts.

headline.zh:
把纠正留在
下一次运行之前。
headline.en:
Keep the correction
before the next run.

sub.zh: MIT 开源的本地 CLI：约束是仓库里的 YAML，快照是 git ref。
sub.en: An MIT-licensed local CLI: constraints are YAML in the repository, snapshots are git refs.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 本地 CLI · 约束与快照都留在 git 里
tag.en: MIT open source · local CLI · constraints and snapshots stay in git
